mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, name, instruction_md, squad_id, initial_agent_id, schedule_type, run_at, cron_expression, timezone, session_mode, overlap_policy, misfire_policy, start_deadline_seconds, affinity_timeout_seconds, status, next_fire_at, last_fire_at, gmt_create, gmt_modified, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheduled_task (workspace_id, name, instruction_md, squad_id, initial_agent_id, schedule_type, run_at, cron_expression, timezone, session_mode, overlap_policy, misfire_policy, start_deadline_seconds, affinity_timeout_seconds, status, next_fire_at, last_fire_at, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{instructionMd}, #{squadId}, #{initialAgentId}, #{scheduleType}, #{runAt}, #{cronExpression}, #{timezone}, #{sessionMode}, #{overlapPolicy}, #{misfirePolicy}, #{startDeadlineSeconds}, #{affinityTimeoutSeconds}, #{status}, #{nextFireAt}, #{lastFireAt}, #{creatorId}, #{modifierId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM scheduled_task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM scheduled_task WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM scheduled_task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status = 'RUNNING' THEN t.id END) AS running, SUM(CASE WHEN r.scheduled_at >= DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR) - INTERVAL 8 HOUR AND r.scheduled_at < DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR) + INTERVAL 16 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS today, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND r.scheduled_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success30d,
SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELED','TIMED_OUT') AND r.scheduled_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed30d, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status IN ('FAILED','PAUSED') THEN t.id END) AS attention FROM scheduled_task t LEFT JOIN scheduled_task_run r ON r.scheduled_task_id = t.id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = #{status} AND t.squad_id = #{squadId} AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_task SET next_fire_at = #{nextFireAt}, last_fire_at = #{lastFireAt}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (next_fire_at = #{expectedNextFireAt} OR (next_fire_at IS NULL AND #{expectedNextFireAt} IS NULL)) AND #{status} IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXHAUSTED')

UPDATE scheduled_task SET name = #{name}, instruction_md = #{instructionMd}, squad_id = #{squadId}, initial_agent_id = #{initialAgentId}, schedule_type = #{scheduleType}, run_at = #{runAt}, cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, timezone = #{timezone}, session_mode = #{sessionMode}, overlap_policy = #{overlapPolicy}, misfire_policy = #{misfirePolicy}, start_deadline_seconds = #{startDeadlineSeconds}, affinity_timeout_seconds = #{affinityTimeoutSeconds}, next_fire_at = #{nextFireAt}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE scheduled_task SET status = #{targetStatus}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND #{targetStatus} IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'EXHAUSTED', 'ARCHIVED') AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
